name: opensource_92B_DSA_A3_BF16_4P8_1D8_omnicache
description: Companion to the XP8_1D8 OmniCache Ansible, configured as 4P8_1D8 (four TP16 P, one DP16 D). MODEL_PATH follows its INT8 checkpoint despite the BF16 directory name. OMNI_ENABLE_OMNI_CACHE=1 enables V2; ENABLE_OMNI_CACHE=0 bypasses legacy setup.

group_configs.description: Replace image/resource IDs and MODEL_PATH. Image must include matching OmniInfer, OmniCache V2 and built native transfer libraries. Expose writable 2 MiB hugetlbfs at /dev/hugepages: 1200 GiB per P node, 600 GiB per D node.

unit_configs.cmd:
KV_TRANSFER_CONFIG=$(python3 -c 'import json, os, subprocess
config = json.loads(os.environ["OMNI_CACHE_V2_KV_TRANSFER_CONFIG"])
topology = subprocess.check_output(
    ["python3", "/workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts/get_node_ip_list.py"],
    text=True,
).strip()
groups = [group.split(",") for group in topology.split(";")]
prefill_count = int(os.environ["PREFILL_INSTANCE_NUM"])
if prefill_count < 1 or len(groups) != prefill_count + 1 or any(len(group) != 1 for group in groups):
    raise ValueError("Expected PREFILL_INSTANCE_NUM single-node P groups and one single-node D group")
pod_ip = os.environ["POD_IP"]
if sum(group.count(pod_ip) for group in groups) != 1:
    raise ValueError("POD_IP must occur exactly once in the ModelArts topology")
extra = config["kv_connector_extra_config"]
if config["kv_role"] == "kv_producer":
    config["engine_id"] = str([group[0] for group in groups[:-1]].index(pod_ip))
    extra["ox_advertised_endpoints"] = pod_ip + ":16077"
else:
    if pod_ip != groups[-1][0]:
        raise ValueError("Decode POD_IP must belong to the last topology group")
    config["engine_id"] = str(prefill_count)
logger.info(json.dumps(config, separators=(",", ":")))') && bash /workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts/proxy.sh --core-num 4 --start-core-index 16 --subrequest-output-buffer-size 10M --omni-proxy-pd-policy sequential --omni-proxy-max-batch-num-token 100000 --omni-proxy-prefill-max-num-seqs 12 --omni-proxy-decode-max-num-seqs 4 && bash /workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts/prefill.sh --max-model-len 524288 --block-size 128 --no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager --enable-expert-parallel --max-num-seqs 3 --mamba-block-size 128 --enable-prefix-caching --enable-chunked-prefill --dtype bfloat16 --kv-cache-dtype li_int8_ds_mla --reasoning-parser pangu --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser pangu --enable-lopt --lopt-pool-size 16 --lopt-chunk-size 4096 --reasoning-config '{"reasoning_start_str":"<think>","reasoning_end_str":"</think>"}' --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' --max-num-batched-tokens 65536 --enforce-eager --additional-config '{"enable_low_latency":true,"enable_omni_cache":true}' --kv-transfer-config "$KV_TRANSFER_CONFIG" && sleep infinity
unit_configs.name: prefill-0
